prompt:
Independently audit this contract against the indexed spec only.
Check (1) every spec segment mapped to a rule or marked unrelated/missing, (2) absent verbatim
evidence without uncertain, (3) contradictions between rule fields and examples, (4) plausible
alternative semantics with a concrete distinguishing chronological input sequence, and (5) derive
outputs for any explicit spec waveform/table/examples and compare. Report distinct material issues.
Return JSON {coverage:{Sxx:[rule IDs or "unrelated"/"missing"]},issues:[
{issue_id,rule_id (or "global"),type:"coverage"|"grounding"|"consistency"|"ambiguity"|"spec_example",
severity:"high"|"medium"|"low",detail,spec_evidence (verbatim spec or ""),alternative,sequence}]}.
Keep any deliberation brief and use short issue descriptions so the entire JSON fits. For ambiguity
the alternative must be specific; sequence must be a nonempty list of complete
width-valid nonclock input rows (optional mid) using the contract ports. For other types alternative
can be an empty string and sequence can be []. Code and prose outside JSON are not needed.
Indexed specification:
{"S01":"This is a sequential circuit.","S02":"Read the simulation waveforms to determine what the circuit does, then implement it.","S03":"// time            clk             a               q","S04":"// 0ns             0               1               x","S05":"// 5ns             1               1               4","S06":"// 10ns            0               1               4","S07":"// 15ns            1               1               4","S08":"// 20ns            0               1               4","S09":"// 25ns            1               1               4","S10":"// 30ns            0               1               4","S11":"// 35ns            1               1               4","S12":"// 40ns            0               1               4","S13":"// 45ns            1               0               4","S14":"// 50ns            0               0               4","S15":"// 55ns            1               0               5","S16":"// 60ns            0               0               5","S17":"// 65ns            1               0               6","S18":"// 70ns            0               0               6","S19":"// 75ns            1               0               0","S20":"// 80ns            0               0               0","S21":"// 85ns            1               0               1","S22":"// 90ns            0               0               1"}
Contract JSON:
{"ports":{"inputs":{"a":1},"outputs":{"q":3},"clock":"clk"},"states":[{"name":"count","meaning":"3-bit counter value stored in q; increments by 1 on each posedge when a=0, holds when a=1","update_time":"posedge","update_during_reset":false}],"rules":[{"id":"R1","outputs":["q"],"condition":"a == 1","edge":"posedge","visible":"next_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"45ns            1               0               4","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"a":1},{"a":1},{"a":1}],"expected":[{"q":4},{"q":4},{"q":4}]}},{"id":"R2","outputs":["q"],"condition":"a == 0","edge":"posedge","visible":"next_cycle","priority":2,"spec_quote":"55ns            1               0               5","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"a":0},{"a":0},{"a":0}],"expected":[{"q":5},{"q":6},{"q":0}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"none","name":null,"active":"none","values":{"q":null},"first_released_cycle":"0ns"},"mid":"Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row.","uncertain":[]}
